tickets.title: Screen debt refinance opportunity
tickets.text: Compare current loan terms with proposed terms, including rate, remaining term, closing costs, cash-flow impact, break-even period, and planning risks before recommending next steps. Prepare a side-by-side review for Liora and Benji Nettlewhisk's primary mortgage (about $742,000 balance, adjustable rate scheduled to reset in 2025) comparing the current adjustable mortgage against fixed-rate and shorter-term refinance quotes, including closing costs, monthly payment impact, and the point at which refinancing would offset upfront costs.
tickets.evidence: Liora asked for a side-by-side review of the current adjustable mortgage against fixed-rate and shorter-term refinance quotes, including closing costs, monthly payment impact, and the point at which refinancing would offset upfront costs; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-06-03.

tickets.title: Analyze mortgage reset timing for refinance decision
tickets.text: Analyze the timing of the upcoming rate change window for Liora and Benji Nettlewhisk's primary mortgage and provide a recommendation on whether to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender before the 2025 reset.
tickets.evidence: the mortgage servicer’s notice shows an upcoming rate change window, and the household wants a recommendation early enough to decide whether to lock a refinance quote or remain with the current lender; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-30.

tickets.title: Collect missing HELOC statement pages
tickets.text: Obtain the missing pages of the partial HELOC statement from the portal for Liora and Benji Nettlewhisk, including the margin, draw-period terms, and repayment conversion language needed to model the combined debt picture (current HELOC balance about $96,000).
tickets.evidence: the portal file contains only a partial HELOC statement, and the missing pages include the margin, draw-period terms, and repayment conversion language needed to model the combined debt picture; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-20.

tickets.title: Reconcile escrow and budget property tax figures
tickets.text: Reconcile the mortgage servicer's escrow estimate with Liora Nettlewhisk's household budget for monthly property tax and insurance amounts to clarify the projected payment after the loan reset on the primary mortgage.
tickets.evidence: the mortgage servicer’s escrow estimate and Liora’s household budget show different monthly property tax and insurance amounts, creating uncertainty in the projected payment after the loan reset; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-27.

tickets.title: Resolve Teacup Comet Bank HELOC autopay double-draft
tickets.text: Resolve the double-draft issue with Teacup Comet Bank where the HELOC autopay was drafted twice in one cycle, temporarily reducing the checking account cushion for Liora and Benji Nettlewhisk and forcing a transfer from savings before payroll posted.
tickets.evidence: Liora reported that Teacup Comet Bank drafted the HELOC autopay twice in one cycle, temporarily reducing the checking account cushion and forcing a transfer from savings before payroll posted; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-05-21.

tickets.title: Review share sale for debt repayment
tickets.text: Review whether selling Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares from Liora Nettlewhisk's Velvet Acorn Custody account could pay off the credit card balance (about $11,200) and part of the auto loan (about $28,400), accounting for tax lots by holding period and unrealized gain to reduce concentration risk.
tickets.evidence: a portfolio review showed that selling enough Cloudberry Kite Robotics shares to pay off the credit card balance and part of the auto loan could reduce concentration risk, but the tax lots vary significantly by holding period and unrealized gain; the agreed follow-up is due 2025-06-10.
